jobs.prompt: A medium tracking shot opens on a 30-year-old female clockmaker with short, silver-streaked hair, wearing a worn leather apron over a dark turtleneck. She sits at a wooden workbench in a dimly lit, cozy workshop flooded by warm amber backlight spilling through dusty window panes. With steady hands, she carefully lowers a glowing brass gear into a complex mechanical clock movement using fine tweezers. The camera performs a slow, smooth dolly-in towards her face as her eyes widen slightly and her lips curve into a subtle smile. Soft ambient ticking of multiple pendulum clocks fills the room alongside the faint metallic clink of precision tools.
